timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: What is Defender for Cloud? Is it just another antivirus?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Way more than that. It's two things: posture management and workload protection.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: Posture management? Is my server supposed to do yoga?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: CSPM checks your cloud configuration continuously. Misconfigurations become visible.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: CWPP protects your actual workloads: servers, databases, containers, storage.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: What's the secure score I keep hearing about?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: It's a number from 0 to 100. Higher means better posture. It tracks your progress.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: Does it work with AWS and GCP too?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Yes. Multicloud support means one dashboard for all your cloud environments.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: What about attack path analysis? That sounds intense.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: It maps how an attacker could reach your critical assets. Visual, actionable, powerful.
